keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.
unmapAll

# Basic movement
map d scrollLeft
map h scrollDown
map t scrollUp
map n scrollRight
map gg scrollToTop
map G scrollToBottom

# Tabs
map H previousTab
map T nextTab
map q removeTab
map Q restoreTab
map p reload
map M createTab
map D goBack
map N goForward
map [[ goPrevious
map ]] goNext
map z moveTabToNewWindow

# Links
map mm copyCurrentUrl
map r Vomnibar.activate
map R Vomnibar.activateNewTab
map b Vomnibar.activateBookmarks
map B Vomnibar.activateBookmarksInNewTab
map L openCopiedUrlInNewTab

# Finding / Selection
map u LinkHints.activateMode
map U LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewForegroundTab
map x enterVisualMode
map X enterVisualLineMode
map c enterInsertMode
map / enterFindMode
map l performFind
map L performBackwardsFind

# Other
map ic focusInput
map ? showHelp
